flaws.text: Technical Scope says to "Fill the reserved `LIFECYCLE: review-gate` branch in `getNext()`; route each boundary's gated status to `review` / `blocked`", and the Overview says the four boundaries ship through it, including pre-slice-plan ("extend the no-active-slice / pre-slice-plan path for the `arch` gate"). In `WorkflowNavigator.ts` at `fb0f3f50^` that branch (line 248) sits after the `GUARD: no-active-slice` block (line 98), which returns on every path before it. A project at the pre-slice-plan boundary has no active slice, and `deriveSliceStatus` returns `no-active-slice` for an unset `fileSlice` (line 453), so a gated status for the arch boundary can never reach the reserved branch. The design also never says which index looks up the arch review (`detectDocuments(path, sliceIndex, reviewType)` takes a slice index; arch reviews carry the arch index). **VALID**: contradicts code. Needs: code. Corroboration (a lead, not the proof): `d9466c5d` later adds an implementation note that the arch gate had to be evaluated before `detectFirstRunContext`, outside the sketched path.

note: Borderline: r03[0] and r05[4] (and r06[5]) address only the undefined arch review index, not the unreachable reserved branch; r02[4] notes the guard interaction but says the mechanism works; r11[1] covers the arch guard-before-branch issue as a secondary point.
